The "野獸先輩" MOD

This MOD adds this 野獸前輩 items and blocks.

 

Forge is required before 1.16

1.17 requires Fabric API

From 1.19 onwards, Architecture API is required, FabricAPI is required for Fabric , and QFAPI/QSL is required for Quilt .

 

 

Do not install if you do not know Yaju Senpai

Take no responsibility for feeling sick or destroying the world

 

World backup recommended before installation.

 

This is just a japanese meme mod, not a virus.

If you can't trust it, check the source code.
